fusions.name: Leap and Latch
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target, then bite it for 12 damage and leave it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hop Along
fusions.desc: A hopping bite that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then jumps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Fresh Host
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds. You also have +5% dodge chance.
